chunks.text: Been thinking about a quick trip starting from Beijing, and Shanghai keeps coming up as the destination, but I’m still kind of on the fence.
Also, if I end up doing more time in town first, I might just look at hotels in Beijing and see what’s even reasonable.
For the train idea, I keep circling back to that G1 option in my head, though I haven’t decided if I’d actually take it.
If I did take the train, it would probably be on 2026-04-05, under Emily Wang, and I’d most likely just do Second Class.
And separately, I’ve been eyeing Park Hyatt Beijing for a stay—checking in 2026-05-15 for 4 nights, guest name Zhou Jun—but we’ll see, probably won’t pull this off.
